I rebuilt my portfolio, and while I was in there I rewrote how I describe myself.
For the last year I've been working as a backend engineer too — NestJS services, PostgreSQL schemas, Drizzle data layers. And I've been going back to the fundamentals: data structures & algorithms, OOP, system design. Because that's where senior engineering actually lives, AI era or not.

The site is my work, not a template:
▪ A six-palette design system with runtime switching and zero theme flash
▪ ⌘K command palette, scroll-spy nav, one shared breakpoint set
▪ A "Now" section wired to the CMS — my live learning tracks (DevOps: Linux → Terraform → AWS from · Databases: MySQL & PostgreSQL)
▪ Contentful-driven, ISR, statically optimized
Next.js 16 · React · TypeScript · Motion · Tailwind · Contentful · NestJS · PostgreSQL

I'm open to Senior Frontend Engineer / Full-Stack Engineer roles — remote or Egypt-based. If you're hiring, or you know a team that is, I'd love a conversation. DM me.
